subject: crtf-d
title: CRTF.D.------ALT.F.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 276 (CMOA(II)-34). CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From CULT-INFO-DY: POL-DY (political dynamics), DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance). From DYM-F: INFO-DS (information dissemination). From PROJ-CONT: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From INFO-DS: STF (source transfer).
